note: REQ-MAT-51 / REQ-FIN-58 (D.3-31): MAT motion rules at error over src/**. Each row is a finding that existed when the guard was widened, in a file another WP owns; the row is routed to that WP as a clause transfer and expires at RC-1. scripts/mat/motion-lint-l1.mjs fails on any finding without a row, on a count above its row, on a row whose count is now lower or zero (delete or lower it: the baseline only shrinks), and on any row under --enforce-zero.
